name: garden-log
description: Personal garden journal: Nuxt frontend and FastAPI backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors green,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "uv run --project backend uvicorn app:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8701" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.check: npm --workspace frontend run build && uv run --project backend python -m compileall -q backend/app.py backend/db.py backend/security.py backend/schemas.py backend/reset_db.py backend/routers
